_readme: Maps each Sleeper user_id to the manager's real first name, for potential future display on the site. This is reference data only right now - build_overview.py does NOT read this file, so the site still shows Sleeper usernames everywhere (League History, Historical Overview, Points For/Against). Wire it in later (e.g. as a display_name source alongside current_names in build_overview.py) whenever ready to switch over.
